segments.contextAfter: `condition`: The focus state to bind. When focus moves to the view, the binding sets the bound value to `true`. If a caller sets the value to  `true` programmatically, then focus moves to the modified view. When focus leaves the modified view, the binding sets the value to `false`. If a caller sets the value to `false`, SwiftUI automatically dismisses focus.
